# exo_organization_customization (Resource)

Enables organization customization for the tenant (Enable-OrganizationCustomization), hydrating a dehydrated tenant so custom objects (role groups, policies, ...) can be created. Idempotent: applying it when already customized is a no-op. Irreversible: destroying this resource only drops it from state — the tenant stays customized.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Hydrate a dehydrated tenant so custom objects (role groups, policies, ...) can
# be created. Other resources should depend on this on a fresh tenant.
resource "exo_organization_customization" "this" {}

resource "exo_role_group" "example" {
  name       = "tf-managed"
  depends_on = [exo_organization_customization.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization identity.
- `is_dehydrated` (Boolean) Whether the organization is still dehydrated. May remain true briefly after enabling while customization finishes provisioning.
